item.tib: 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga
item.skt: Ar+ya many+dzu shrI nA ma saM gI ti maN+Da la bi d+hi
item.coloph: 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /paN+Di ta shAn+ti gar+b+has mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /lo tsA ba smri ti dz+nyA na kIrtis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o//
